description: Settings for configuring Eigen's implementation of conjugate gradients.

max-iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations to perform.

relative-residual.description: Stop iterating once the residual's 2-norm divided by the initial residual's 2-norm drops below this value.

verbosity.description: Level of logging during iterations (0 - none, 1 - warnings, 2 - summaries, 3 - iteration summaries, 4 - debug).
